readings: For each circuit (`races.circuitId`), count its races and compute its share of all races (its count divided by the total number of races across all circuits). Keep only circuits whose share is greater than the average share across circuits. Return the circuit Id, race count, share, and how much the share exceeds the average share, sorted by that excess from highest to lowest, and give the top 10 by that excess, also including any circuits tied with the 10th one.
queries:
WITH circuit_counts AS (
    SELECT circuitId, COUNT(*) AS race_count
    FROM races
    GROUP BY circuitId
),
circuit_shares AS (
    SELECT circuitId,
           race_count,
           1.0 * race_count / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM races) AS share
    FROM circuit_counts
),
above_average AS (
    SELECT circuitId,
           race_count,
           share,
           share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM circuit_shares) AS excess
    FROM circuit_shares
    WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM circuit_shares)
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *,
           RANK() OVER (ORDER BY excess DESC) AS share_rank
    FROM above_average
)
SELECT circuitId, race_count, share, excess
FROM ranked
WHERE share_rank <= 10
ORDER BY excess DESC
